why: Each throw breaks the eye with probability 0.2, independently. Expected loss = 3 x 0.2 = 0.6. P(no break) = 0.8^3 = 0.512. So about half the time you arrive with fewer than 12 eyes, which matters if the portal has no pre-filled frames.
trap: 0.488 for (2): that is the chance at least one breaks. The wiki's own sentence mixes these up ('approximately a 50% overall chance to shatter ... 0.8^3 = 51.2%').

techniques.description: Carry spare eyes for the 20% break rate.

sources: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Eye_of_Ender (raw line 32: 20% shatter, 80% survive per throw)
